title: Exact mass asymptotics for the two-dimensional O(4) lattice model
summary: For the nearest-neighbor $`O(4)`$ model on the square lattice at inverse temperature β , we prove the exact low-temperature asymptotic $`\displaystyle m_{\mathrm{lat}}(\beta)\sim 32\exp(\pi/4-1/2)\sqrt\beta\,\exp(-\pi\beta) \qquad (\beta\to\infty).`$ Here the mass is the gap of the full Osterwalder–Schrader transfer operator, including rotation-invariant local-observable sectors, in units of one original lattice time step.
family_title: Canonical $`O(3)`$ continuum limit and exact $`O(4)`$ mass asymptotics
